CREATE VIEW [Security].[VWSecurityEntity] AS 
                       SELECT ID, EnglishPrefix, ArabicPrefix, EnglishName, ArabicName, IsActive, IsDeleted, PO_Box, Telephone, Address, FAXNo, VATNo, LOGO, NPHIESCode
                       FROM [Security].[Entity]

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VWRolePermission]
AS
SELECT        Security.BusinessAction.Name AS BusinessActionName, Security.Permission.Name AS PermissionName, Security.BusinessEntity.Name AS BusinessEntityName, 
                         Security.Role.Name AS RoleName, Security.Permission.IsStatic, Security.Permission.ID AS PermissionID, Security.RolePermission.ID AS RolePermissionID, 
                         Security.Role.ID AS RoleID, Security.BusinessAction.ID AS BusinessActionID
FROM            Security.BusinessAction INNER JOIN
                         Security.Permission ON Security.BusinessAction.ID = Security.Permission.BusinessActionID INNER JOIN
                         Security.BusinessEntity ON Security.Permission.BusinessEntityID = Security.BusinessEntity.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.RolePermission ON Security.Permission.ID = Security.RolePermission.PermissionID INNER JOIN
                         Security.Role ON Security.RolePermission.RoleID = Security.Role.ID
						 where  Security.RolePermission.IsDeleted=0
						 and Security.Role.IsDeleted = 0

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VWUserModules] AS
                         SELECT DISTINCT 
                         Security.[User].ID AS UserId, dbo.VWRolePermission.PermissionName, Security.Page.ArName AS PageName, Security.Page.ID AS PageId, 
                         Security.Module.ID AS ChildModuleId, Security.Module.ParentID AS ChildModuleParentId, Security.ClientAction.ID AS ClientActionId, 
                         Security.ClientAction.Name AS ClientActionName, Security.Module.Name AS ChildModuleName, ParentModule.Name AS ParentModuleName, 
                         ParentModule.ID AS ParentModuleId, Security.Page.URL AS PageURL, Security.Page.EnName AS PageEnglishName, Security.Page.PageKey, 
                         Security.Page.IsActive AS PageIsActive, Security.Page.IsStatic AS PageIsStatic, Security.Page.ProcessKey AS PageProcessKey, 
                         ParentModule.PageKey AS ParentModulePageKey, Security.Module.PageKey AS ChildModulePageKey, Security.Module.EnName AS ChildModuleEnglishName, 
                         ParentModule.EnName AS ParentModuleEnglishName, ParentModule.URL AS ParentModuleURL, Security.Module.URL AS ChildModuleURL, 
                         dbo.VWRolePermission.IsStatic AS PermissionIsStatic, dbo.VWRolePermission.PermissionID AS PermissionID
                         FROM Security.[User] INNER JOIN
                         Security.UserRole ON Security.[User].ID = Security.UserRole.UserID INNER JOIN
                         Security.ClientAction INNER JOIN
                         Security.PageActionAccess ON Security.ClientAction.ID = Security.PageActionAccess.ActionID INNER JOIN
                         Security.Page ON Security.PageActionAccess.PageID = Security.Page.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.PageActionPermission ON Security.PageActionAccess.ID = Security.PageActionPermission.PageActionID INNER JOIN
                         /*Security.Role ON Security.RolePermission.RoleID = Security.Role.ID INNER JOIN*/ dbo.VWRolePermission ON 
                         dbo.VWRolePermission.PermissionID = Security.PageActionPermission.PermissionID INNER JOIN
                         Security.Module ON Security.Page.ModuleId = Security.Module.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.Module AS ParentModule ON Security.Module.ParentID = ParentModule.ID ON Security.UserRole.RoleID = dbo.VWRolePermission.RoleID
                         UNION
                         SELECT NULL, 
                         name AS PermissionName, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
                         IsStatic AS PermissionIsStatic, ID AS PermissionID
                         FROM [Security].[Permission]
                         WHERE IsStatic = 1

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VWuserServerPermission]
AS
SELECT DISTINCT 
                         Security.[User].ID, Security.APIController.Name AS ControllerName, Security.WebAction.Name AS ActionMethodName, 
                         Security.ProjectService.Name AS ModuleServiceName, Security.Permission.IsStatic, Security.Permission.ID AS PermissionID
FROM            Security.APIController INNER JOIN
                         Security.ProjectService ON Security.APIController.ProjectServiceId = Security.ProjectService.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.WebAction ON Security.APIController.ID = Security.WebAction.APIControllerID INNER JOIN
                         Security.WebActionPermission ON Security.WebAction.ID = Security.WebActionPermission.WebActionId INNER JOIN
                         Security.Permission ON Security.WebActionPermission.PermissionId = Security.Permission.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.RolePermission ON Security.Permission.ID = Security.RolePermission.PermissionId INNER JOIN
                         Security.Role ON Security.RolePermission.RoleId = Security.Role.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.UserRole ON Security.Role.ID = Security.UserRole.RoleId INNER JOIN
                         Security.[User] ON Security.UserRole.UserId = Security.[User].ID
WHERE        Security.RolePermission.IsDeleted = 0 AND Security.[User].IsDeleted = 0
UNION
SELECT        NULL, Security.APIController.Name AS ControllerName, Security.WebAction.Name AS ActionMethodName, Security.ProjectService.Name AS ModuleServiceName, 
                         Security.Permission.IsStatic, Security.Permission.ID AS PermissionID
FROM            Security.APIController INNER JOIN
                         Security.ProjectService ON Security.APIController.ProjectServiceId = Security.ProjectService.ID INNER JOIN
                         Security.WebAction ON Security.APIController.ID = Security.WebAction.APIControllerID INNER JOIN
                         Security.WebActionPermission ON Security.WebAction.ID = Security.WebActionPermission.WebActionId INNER JOIN
                         Security.Permission ON Security.WebActionPermission.PermissionId = Security.Permission.ID
WHERE        Permission.IsStatic = 1

                        CREATE VIEW [dbo].[VWUserUnModuledPage] AS
                        
                            SELECT DISTINCT 
				                        AHBSuser.ID AS UserId, permsion.Name As PermissionName, 
				                        pg.ArName AS PageName, pg.ID AS PageId,pg.URL AS PageURL,
				                        ClientAction.ID AS ClientActionId, ClientAction.Name AS ClientActionName,
				                        pg.EnName AS PageEnglishName,  pg.PageKey, pg.IsActive AS PageIsActive,
				                        pg.IsStatic AS PageIsStatic, pg.ProcessKey AS PageProcessKey, 
				                        permsion.IsStatic AS PermissionIsStatic, permsion.ID AS PermissionID
                       
                        FROM 
		                        [Security].[Page] pg INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[PageActionAccess] pgactionacss on pg.ID=pgactionacss.PageID INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[ClientAction] ClientAction on ClientAction.ID =pgactionacss.ActionID INNER JOIN
		                        [Security].[PageActionPermission] pgactionprmsion on pgactionacss.ID=pgactionprmsion.PageActionID INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[Permission] permsion on pgactionprmsion.PermissionID=permsion.ID INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[RolePermission] rolprmsion on permsion.ID=rolprmsion.PermissionID INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[Role] rol on rol.ID=rolprmsion.RoleID INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[UserRole] userrole on userrole.RoleID  =rol.ID INNER JOIN 
		                        [Security].[User] AHBSuser on AHBSuser.ID=userrole.UserID
                        WHERE	pg.ModuleId is null and rolprmsion.IsDeleted=0 and rol.IsDeleted=0
                        UNION
                        SELECT 
		                        NULL,name AS PermissionName,
		                        NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 
                                IsStatic AS PermissionIsStatic, ID AS PermissionID
                        FROM 
		                        [Security].[Permission]
                        WHERE	IsStatic = 1
